coverage: Real canonical image artifacts, version pinning, unchanged original bytes, derivative event metadata
Persistent editable strokes, optimistic conflicts, concurrent writers, idempotent create/export
PNG dimensions, blank canvas, transparency, EXIF orientation, draw/erase/undo semantics
Actual aiohttp create/update/reload/source/export routes and invalid/oversized requests
Independent homes cannot resolve each other's artifacts or sketches
Console entry, bounded controls and empty-state SSR rendering

integration_hooks.agent: SketchStore create/get/list/update/export/source via registered authenticated HTTP operations

remaining_limits: Actual browser draw/erase/undo/save/export journey and integrated console typecheck/build remain pending
Current console checks render SSR entry controls; they do not qualify browser canvas interactions
The list returns the latest 100 sketches; older sketches remain accessible by ID
Hosted auth qualification is recorded separately by its owner
